intro: Bozeman has a small but growing public sauna scene: a downtown bathhouse inspired by the Slavic banya, an outdoor sauna and cold plunge club on the Northside, and a long-running hot springs facility west of town with a dry sauna and steam room alongside its pools. Umvelt sells two-hour sessions, PORTAL runs bookable sessions on a credit system, and Bozeman Hot Springs sells day admission at the door. Prices, hours and session formats change, so confirm with each venue before you go.

venues.name: Umvelt Bathhouse
venues.schedule: Mon and Wed-Fri 8am-9pm, Sat-Sun 9am-9pm, closed Tuesdays (venue notes hours vary by day and season). Co-ed, 18+. Reservations advised; walk-ins admitted first come, first served when space allows.
venues.notes: Banya-inspired bathhouse with a large high-humidity event sauna (196°F, up to 30 guests), a smaller Finnish dry sauna (185°F), a eucalyptus steam room, a cold plunge and a warm pool. Swimwear required (no underwear or street clothes). Phone-free bathhouse floor; speak softly. Two towels and body wash provided; bring a water bottle. No outside food. Massage can be booked separately. Session packs and memberships available.

venues.name: PORTAL° Bozeman
venues.drop_in_price: Credits $32.50 each (6 for $162.50, 12 for $325); credits needed per session Unknown on the venue page
venues.session_length: Unknown (fixed booking window; venue suggests three rounds of about 15 minutes heat and 3 minutes cold)
venues.schedule: Sun-Tue and Thu-Sat 8am-10pm, Wed 4pm-10pm. Book sessions in advance online. Waiver required.
venues.notes: Outdoor club with two saunas, five cold plunge tubs, a rooftop deck and an indoor clubhouse; opened March 2026. Heat source not stated. Bring a swimsuit, towel and water bottle; sauna towels are complimentary and bath towels can be rented. Arrive clean; showers on site and rinse stations before the plunges. Free on-site parking, first come, first served. Memberships $99-$279/month; credits work at other PORTAL clubs.

venues.name: Bozeman Hot Springs
venues.neighborhood: West of Bozeman (8 miles west on US 191)
venues.address: Unknown street address on the venue's own site (8 miles west of Bozeman on US 191; a sauna listing site gives 2100 Stephens Ave #105, Bozeman, MT 59718)
venues.drop_in_price: Adults $28 weekdays, $34 weekends and holidays ($21 / $28 with Montana ID); Full Facility pass $42 weekdays, $50 weekends ($35 / $40 with Montana ID). Which pass includes the sauna is not stated.
venues.cold_plunge: Cold pool in the indoor area next to the hottest pool (pools range 57-106°F)
venues.schedule: Mon-Thu 5:30am-11pm; Fri 5:30am-sundown; Sat sundown-midnight; Sunday hours Unknown (check the venue calendar). All ages.
venues.notes: Hot springs facility with 12 naturally heated pools, plus a dry sauna and a steam room in the indoor pool area. Indoor pools are drained and cleaned nightly; the three main outdoor pools are chlorinated. Live music in the outdoor pools on Thursdays and Sundays. Also has a fitness center, cafe and campground. Accepts cash, Mastercard and Visa.
